products.name: OpenShell
products.tagline: Try OpenShell on OpenShift with ODH midstream images
products.description: OpenShell provides isolated execution environments for autonomous AI agents, governed by declarative policies. Start with the Agent Ops walkthrough, then explore public ODH midstream images and build status. Red Hat Data Services (RHDS) is the downstream source.
products.requirements: For the getting-started guide: an isolated OpenShift 4.21+ test cluster, cluster administrator access, oc, Helm, Agent Sandbox, dynamic storage, and inference-provider credentials. Follow the guide for required versions and permissions.
